caption:
HOW TO RELIGHT A PHOTO YOU ALREADY SHOT

This one was taken against a plain yellow wall. No smoke machine, no gels, no second flash — the wine background and the red edge were added afterwards, by light.

The five steps are in the images above:
1. Pick your output size, and crop your photo to it first
2. Upload the photo (1–10 at a time, you pay per photo)
3. Pick from 196 looks, grouped by shot size
4. Press and hold any look to preview it on YOUR photo
5. Choose a backdrop if you want one, then generate

₦1,000 per photo. No subscription — you pay for the photos you make.

👉 aluxartandframes.shop

slides.title: How I made this.
slides.body: A photo shot against a plain yellow wall, relit as “Wine Dark Backlight”. Step by step 👉

slides.title: 1. Pick the size first.
slides.body: It opens on *3:4*. Whatever you choose, crop your photo to that shape BEFORE you upload — a different shape gets cropped to fit and you can lose part of the frame.

slides.title: 2. Upload the photo.
slides.body: One to ten photos, and you pay per photo. The looks are grouped by *headshot*, *waist-up* and *full body*, so you judge each one on the crop you actually shot.

slides.title: 3. Pick a look.
slides.body: 196 of them, each one named. This is where “Wine Dark Backlight” lives — under *Medium shots*, because that is the crop it was built for.

slides.title: 4. Preview before you commit.
slides.body: Press and hold any look to see it against the original. *Drag to compare.* You are not guessing from a thumbnail.

slides.title: 5. Backdrop, only if you want one.
slides.body: Keep your own background, pick a studio backdrop, or upload your own. Then *Pay & Generate* — ₦1,000 for one photo.

slides.title: That's the whole thing.
slides.body: No smoke machine, no second flash, no subscription. Open it and try one photo: *aluxartandframes.shop*
